_note: Our own plain-English descriptions for currency-type items, shown in item tooltips. Unique, base, essence and rune stats come from game data instead (see scripts/build-item-tooltips.mjs).

currency.Orb of Transmutation: Upgrades a Normal item to a Magic item with 1 modifier
currency.Greater Orb of Transmutation: Upgrades a Normal item to a Magic item with 1 modifier of a higher minimum tier
currency.Perfect Orb of Transmutation: Upgrades a Normal item to a Magic item with 1 modifier of a much higher minimum tier
currency.Orb of Augmentation: Adds a new random modifier to a Magic item with only 1 modifier
currency.Greater Orb of Augmentation: Adds a new random modifier of a higher minimum tier to a Magic item with only 1 modifier
currency.Perfect Orb of Augmentation: Adds a new random modifier of a much higher minimum tier to a Magic item with only 1 modifier
currency.Regal Orb: Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding 1 random modifier
currency.Greater Regal Orb: Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding 1 random modifier of a higher minimum tier
currency.Perfect Regal Orb: Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding 1 random modifier of a much higher minimum tier
currency.Orb of Alchemy: Upgrades a Normal item to a Rare item with 4 random modifiers
currency.Exalted Orb: Adds a new random modifier to a Rare item
currency.Greater Exalted Orb: Adds a new random modifier of a higher minimum tier to a Rare item
currency.Perfect Exalted Orb: Adds a new random modifier of a much higher minimum tier to a Rare item
currency.Chaos Orb: Removes a random modifier from a Rare item and adds a new random modifier
currency.Greater Chaos Orb: Removes a random modifier from a Rare item and adds a new random modifier of a higher minimum tier
currency.Perfect Chaos Orb: Removes a random modifier from a Rare item and adds a new random modifier of a much higher minimum tier
currency.Orb of Annulment: Removes a random modifier from an item
currency.Divine Orb: Rerolls the numeric values of the modifiers on an item
currency.Vaal Orb: Corrupts an item with an unpredictable result. Corrupted items can't be changed further by most currency
currency.Orb of Chance: Has a small chance to turn a Normal item into a Unique item. If it fails, the item is destroyed
currency.Fracturing Orb: Locks a random modifier on a Rare item with at least 4 modifiers, so it can't be changed or removed
currency.Mirror of Kalandra: Creates a mirrored copy of an item. Mirrored items can't be modified
currency.Scroll of Wisdom: Identifies an item, revealing its modifiers
currency.Blacksmith's Whetstone: Improves the quality of a martial weapon
currency.Armourer's Scrap: Improves the quality of an armour item
currency.Arcanist's Etcher: Improves the quality of a wand, staff or other caster weapon
currency.Glassblower's Bauble: Improves the quality of a flask
currency.Gemcutter's Prism: Improves the quality of a skill gem
currency.Artificer's Orb: Adds a rune socket to a piece of equipment
currency.Lesser Jeweller's Orb: Adds a support gem socket to a skill gem with fewer than 3
currency.Greater Jeweller's Orb: Adds a support gem socket to a skill gem with fewer than 4
currency.Perfect Jeweller's Orb: Adds a support gem socket to a skill gem with fewer than 5
currency.Transmutation Shard: A fragment of an Orb of Transmutation. Collect enough and they combine into a full orb
currency.Regal Shard: A fragment of a Regal Orb. Collect enough and they combine into a full orb
currency.Chance Shard: A fragment of an Orb of Chance. Collect enough and they combine into a full orb
currency.Artificer's Shard: A fragment of an Artificer's Orb. Collect enough and they combine into a full orb
currency.Gold: Spent at vendors and on refunding passive points. It can't be traded

omens.Omen of Sinistral Exaltation: Your next Exalted Orb only adds a prefix modifier
omens.Omen of Dextral Exaltation: Your next Exalted Orb only adds a suffix modifier
omens.Omen of Greater Exaltation: Your next Exalted Orb adds two random modifiers
omens.Omen of Homogenising Exaltation: Your next Exalted Orb adds a modifier of the same type as an existing one
omens.Omen of Sinistral Coronation: Your next Regal Orb only adds a prefix modifier
omens.Omen of Dextral Coronation: Your next Regal Orb only adds a suffix modifier
omens.Omen of Homogenising Coronation: Your next Regal Orb adds a modifier of the same type as an existing one
omens.Omen of Sinistral Annulment: Your next Orb of Annulment only removes a prefix modifier
omens.Omen of Dextral Annulment: Your next Orb of Annulment only removes a suffix modifier
omens.Omen of Sinistral Erasure: Your next Chaos Orb only removes a prefix modifier
omens.Omen of Dextral Erasure: Your next Chaos Orb only removes a suffix modifier
omens.Omen of Whittling: Your next Chaos Orb removes the lowest level modifier
omens.Omen of Sinistral Alchemy: Your next Orb of Alchemy gives the item the most prefix modifiers it can have
omens.Omen of Dextral Alchemy: Your next Orb of Alchemy gives the item the most suffix modifiers it can have
omens.Omen of Sinistral Crystallisation: Your next Perfect Essence only removes a prefix modifier
omens.Omen of Dextral Crystallisation: Your next Perfect Essence only removes a suffix modifier
omens.Omen of Light: Your next Orb of Annulment only removes Desecrated modifiers

omenGeneric: Omens work automatically while they're in your inventory, and are used up when their effect happens
essence: Upgrades a Magic item to a Rare item, adding a guaranteed modifier
perfectEssence: Removes a random modifier from a Rare item and adds a guaranteed modifier
rune: Place into an empty rune socket on a piece of equipment to apply its effect
jewel: Place into an allocated jewel socket on the passive tree to apply its effect
waystone: Opens a map on the Atlas when placed in the Map Device. Higher tiers have tougher monsters and better loot
tablet: Place into a Precursor Tower to add its effect to the maps around it

uncut.Uncut Skill Gem: Cut it into the skill gem of your choice, up to this gem's level
uncut.Uncut Spirit Gem: Cut it into the Spirit gem of your choice, up to this gem's level
uncut.Uncut Support Gem: Cut it into the support gem of your choice
